title: Preexistence of Christ
definition: The preexistence of Christ means that the Son existed eternally before His incarnation and before all creation.
summary: Jesus existed before Bethlehem as the eternal Son and divine Word.
christFocus: The preexistent Christ entered the world to reveal God and redeem sinners.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Jesus did not begin to exist when He was born of Mary. The Son existed eternally with the Father and the Spirit before creation.

His preexistence shows that the incarnation is divine condescension. The eternal Son humbled Himself by taking on human nature.

Because Christ existed before all things, He is not merely part of history; He is Lord over history and the One through whom all things were made.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Some people treat Jesus as a great man whose story began in Bethlehem. The preexistence of Christ matters because it reveals His divine identity and eternal glory.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Worship Jesus as the eternal Son who came near for your salvation. Let His humility deepen your gratitude and obedience.
